messages:
maya: Heads-up — Sales flagged a handful of leads sitting unassigned in HubSpot for >30m. Can we confirm the current SLA for assignment + enrichment?

alex: Current target is 15m for owner assignment, 45m for enrichment completion. Seeing some failures in the round-robin step — looks like API 429s to the enrichment service.

jamal: Which pipeline/preset? I picked up 3 MQLs from 'Product Interest' that never got assigned.

sophia: Workflow link: https://app.hubspot.com/workflows/1234 (Product Interest routing). It does a Rotate owners action -> then enrichment webhook.

alex: Logs: the rotate action succeeds but the subsequent enrichment webhook times out intermittently. HubSpot retries, but after 3 failed attempts the lead sits with owner empty.

maya: Can we add an SLA escalation so any lead unassigned after 15m triggers a notify to #sales-sla and creates a task for AE on-call? Sales can't be triaging Slack threads all day.

evan: Ping me for urgent ones, but yes — automation would be better. We need an audit trail so we can see why owner assignment failed.

alex: Proposed workflow changes: after 15m unassigned -> set property "escalation_status" = "pending", fire webhook to /internal/sales-sla, and create a task due in 1h. If enrichment webhook fails 3x -> set property "enrichment_status" = "failed" and tag lead with "minimal_enrichment_needed" to allow downstream routing.

maya: Also important: double-check HubSpot -> Salesforce owner mapping. Last month a few leads landed in SF with unmapped owner ids and defaulted to Administrator.

jamal: Mapping table is marketing.hubspot_owner_map in BigQuery. New hires weren't added to the map. We should add a daily sync job that pulls HubSpot owners and updates the map.

sophia: I'll add a runbook entry and schedule a daily Airflow job to sync owner mappings and flag any missing mappings. Also adding a health alert: if >5% of leads in the last 1h have enrichment_status = "failed", page revops.

alex: I'll make the workflow change in staging today at 16:00 PST. Plan: increase webhook timeout to 10s, add fallback minimal enrichment path, and add the 15m escalation branch. Will include rollback steps.

evan: I can smoke test from Sales side — creating a few test contacts and validating they get assigned and flow to SF correctly.

maya: :thumbsup: Please post results here when done. Also note owners: alex -> implement workflow; sophia -> runbook + airflow job; jamal -> update mapping script; evan -> sales smoke test.

revops-bot: deploy-notice: Workflow update pushed to staging by alex at 16:02 PST. Tests queued.

alex: Quick example of the webhook payload I'll send to /internal/sales-sla for escalations:

```
{
  "lead_id": "{{contact.id}}",
  "email": "{{contact.email}}",
  "status": "unassigned",
  "elapsed_minutes": "15"
}
```

maya: Good. After staging verification, please schedule canary to prod during low traffic window. If anything weird, revert to previous workflow and notify #marketing and #sales.

jamal: I'll add a query in Looker to surface owner mapping failures and enrichment failures so we can monitor week-over-week.

sophia: Added to sprint board under RevOps -> "HubSpot enrichment fallback + SLA escalation" with acceptance criteria: automated escalations, daily owner sync, health alerts, and successful end-to-end smoke test.

alex: Thanks team — will update thread after staging smoke tests.
